chunks: Whatever is in it from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan—may Allah have mercy on him—from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa ibn 'Ubayd, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman.

key_terms.النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ: al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, a transmitter in the chain
key_terms.الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ: al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارِ: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, a transmitter in the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Qasim ibn Sulayman in Man la Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman in Man la Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission for hadith verification and preservation.
